Ebola Case Confirmed in Kenya Amid Eastern DRC Outbreak

An imported case of Ebola has been confirmed in Kenya, raising concerns about wider cross-border spread as the virus continues to spread in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Kenya had reportedly prepared for such an eventuality.
